sources.title: AI Classification in Machine Learning Explained
sources.snippet: I data classification, or AI classification, is the process of organizing data into predefined categories. The AI model is taught to recognize features and patterns in information, so it can identify them in any new data sets.

sources.title: Choosing the Best Machine Learning Classification Model and Avoiding Overfitting - MATLAB & Simulink
sources.snippet: Categorizing data points based on their distance to other points in a training data set can be a simple yet effective way of classifying data. k-nearest neighbor (KNN) is the “guilty by association” algorithm. KNN is an instance-based lazy learner, which means there’s no real training phase. You load the training data into the model and let it sit until you actually want to start using the classifier.
